name: Overlapping Delta
reference_analysis: Two overlapping downward-pointing triangular pendants: the lower/larger triangle is an open silver-coloured outline, while the upper triangle has a dark stone-like inset with a fine pale vein and a bright surrounding rim. A small bail joins the upper triangle to a bright chain; a separate dark chain is also visible. The photograph does not certify stone, metal, size or finish.
interpretation: A broad clipped-delta whole-body enclosure tapers toward its lower point, rather than placing triangles on a square box. Its front is built as two physically overlapping triangular levels: a larger low open-outline relief and a smaller raised solid triangular roof with a recessed inset. The complete recorder occupies the closed backing below both triangles. A literal open lower triangle or narrow equilateral body cannot contain the battery, motor and two-level electronics at wearable dimensions, so the delta is truncated and broadened to a 57 x 54 mm nominal footprint. The raised triangle increases the front depth locally to 24 mm and the rear remains flat.
finish_notes: Charcoal body/inset and pale silver-coloured raised rims represent optional nonconductive paint, not specified stone or metal construction. The larger frame is 1.45 mm wide; the smaller inset is recessed 0.4 mm into a physical 2.2 mm-high roof addition. No fake stone vein or unsupported wire-thin edges are modeled. The inset is integral shell material. The lower-right flank is broadened locally to clear the retained motor seat without increasing the overall 57 mm width. See verification.json for completed CAD checks; physical fit, acoustic response, RF, coating compatibility and strength remain untested.
